847.text: Those who, through no fault of their own, do not know the Gospel of Christ or his Church, but who nevertheless seek God with a sincere heart, and, moved by grace, try in their actions to do his will as they know it through the dictates of their conscience - those too may achieve eternal salvation.
847.notes: Quoted sentence only. Quoting Lumen Gentium 16; vatican.va prints a spaced hyphen before 'those too'. Ch. 12 line 121.
